description: This file implements an AES encryption driver for the Linux kernel, supporting multiple modes such as ECB, CBC, CTR, and RFC3686. It manages hardware interaction, request queuing, and cryptographic operations for the Lantiq platform.

methods.name: lq_deu_aes_core
methods.description: Main interface to AES hardware for encryption/decryption, handling key setup, DMA configuration, and data transfer.

methods.name: count_sgs
methods.description: Counts the number of scatterlist entries needed for a total byte size.

methods.name: lq_sg_init
methods.description: Initializes scatterlist mappings for source and destination buffers.

methods.name: lq_sg_complete
methods.description: Frees memory associated with an AES container after processing.

methods.name: aes_container_cast
methods.description: Retrieves the container structure from an ablkcipher_request.

methods.name: process_next_packet
methods.description: Processes the next data packet or scatterlist segment for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: process_queue
methods.description: Tasklet to trigger processing of queued AES requests.

methods.name: aes_crypto_thread
methods.description: Kernel thread managing AES request queue and hardware interaction.

methods.name: lq_aes_queue_mgr
methods.description: Manages queuing of AES requests and initiates hardware processing.

methods.name: aes_setkey
methods.description: Sets the AES key in the context.

methods.name: aes_generic_setkey
methods.description: Wrapper for setting AES key.

methods.name: rfc3686_aes_setkey
methods.description: Sets the key and nonce for RFC3686 mode.

methods.name: aes_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts data using AES.

methods.name: aes_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts data using AES.

methods.name: ecb_aes_encrypt
methods.description: AES ECB mode encryption.

methods.name: ecb_aes_decrypt
methods.description: AES ECB mode decryption.

methods.name: cbc_aes_encrypt
methods.description: AES CBC mode encryption.

methods.name: cbc_aes_decrypt
methods.description: AES CBC mode decryption.

methods.name: ctr_aes_encrypt
methods.description: AES CTR mode encryption.

methods.name: ctr_aes_decrypt
methods.description: AES CTR mode decryption.

methods.name: rfc3686_aes_encrypt
methods.description: RFC3686 mode AES encryption with nonce handling.

methods.name: rfc3686_aes_decrypt
methods.description: RFC3686 mode AES decryption with nonce handling.

methods.name: lqdeu_async_aes_init
methods.description: Initializes the AES driver and registers algorithms.

methods.name: lqdeu_fini_async_aes
methods.description: Unregisters AES algorithms and cleans up driver resources.
